description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::from_chars function, specifically testing floating-point parsing accuracy, rounding behavior, overflow/underflow handling, NaN parsing, and comparison with strtod/strtof. It includes detailed test cases for double and float precision, including edge cases and special values.

methods.name: TestDoubleParse
methods.description: Tests that a string is parsed exactly to the expected double value using absl::from_chars.

methods.name: TestFloatParse
methods.description: Tests that a string is parsed exactly to the expected float value using absl::from_chars.

methods.name: ToFloat
methods.description: Converts a string view to a float using absl::from_chars.

methods.name: ToDouble
methods.description: Converts a string view to a double using absl::from_chars.

methods.name: TestHalfwayValue
methods.description: Tests that values just below, at, and just above the halfway point between two floats round correctly.

methods.name: Identical
methods.description: Checks if two floating point values have identical bit layouts, used for NaN comparisons.
